Attach 1–14 images to edit.');const toDataURL=async(url)=>{if(url.startsWith('data:'))return url;let res;try{res=await fetch(url);}catch(e){throw new Error(`Could not download attached image: ${e.message}`);}if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`Could not download attached image (HTTP ${res.status}). It may require login to view.`);const blob=await res.blob();return await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onloadend=()=>resolve(reader.result);reader.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Failed to read attached image.'));reader.readAsDataURL(blob);});};const dataUrls=await Promise.all(urls.slice(0,14).map(toDataURL));const response=await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/images',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':`Bearer ${apiKey}`,'HTTP-Referer':window.location.origin||'https://typingmind.com','X-Title':'TypingMind Plugin'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5',prompt,n:params.n||parseInt(userSettings.defaultImageCount)||1,resolution:params.resolution||'2K',aspect_ratio:params.aspect_ratio||'1:1',input_references:dataUrls.map(url=>({type:'image_url',image_url:{url}}))})});if(response.status===401)throw new Error('Invalid OpenRouter API key.');if(!response.ok){const text=await response.text();let msg=`Request failed (${response.status})`;try{const e=JSON.parse(text);if(e.error)msg+=`: ${e.error.message||e.error}`;}catch(_){msg+=`: ${text}`;}throw new Error(msg);}const{data}=await response.json();if(!data?.length)throw new Error('No images returned.');return{cards:data.map(img=>({type:'image',image:{url:img.url||`data:${img.media_type||'image/jpeg'};base64,${img.b64_json}`,alt:prompt.replace(/[\[\]]/g,''),sync:true}}))}}

overviewMarkdown:
# Seedream 4.5 Edit

Edit images using ByteDance Seedream 4.5 on OpenRouter. Attach 1–14 reference images to your message, then describe the edit.

## Parameters
- **resolution**: `1K` · `2K` · `4K`
- **aspect_ratio**: `1:1` · `16:9` · `9:16` · `4:3` · `3:2` · and more
- **n**: 1–10 output variations per request

## Setup
1. Get an API key at [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys)
2. Enter it in plugin settings
